# facett_pipeline/lib.rs

[1](https://docs.rs#1)//! **facett-pipeline** — a dataflow / Spark **pipeline DAG** viewer + job
[2](https://docs.rs#2)//! progress, brought up to the facett look: **theme-driven** (every colour from
[3](https://docs.rs#3)//! the active [`Theme`]), **animated flowing edges** (a marching-ants sweep along
[4](https://docs.rs#4)//! each edge showing dataflow direction), **per-stage status glow** (running =
[5](https://docs.rs#5)//! pulse, done = steady accent, failed = red bloom via
[6](https://docs.rs#6)//! [`effects::glow_rect`]), and **throughput labels** on edges.
[7](https://docs.rs#7)//!
[8](https://docs.rs#8)//! It composes [`facett_graph::DepGraphView`] for the **layout** (toposorted
[9](https://docs.rs#9)//! columns) and its `state_json`, but paints its own animated, themed DAG on top.
[10](https://docs.rs#10)//! A [`Facet`], and now **engine-agnostic**: the canonical input is the neutral
[11](https://docs.rs#11)//! [`PipelineModel`] (see [`model`]), produced by an engine's
[12](https://docs.rs#12)//! [`PipelineAdapter`] — so "show another engine's
[13](https://docs.rs#13)//! pipeline" is *a new adapter, not a new viewer* (one-viewer-many-adapters, like
[14](https://docs.rs#14)//! facett-graphview). knut ships the Spark/SDP adapter; build with
[15](https://docs.rs#15)//! [`PipelineView::from_model`] / [`from_adapter`](PipelineView::from_adapter).
[16](https://docs.rs#16)//! The future graphview render path + extra engine adapters are DEFERRED — see the
[17](https://docs.rs#17)//! [`model`] design note.
[18](https://docs.rs#18)//!
[19](https://docs.rs#19)//! ## Back-compat
[20](https://docs.rs#20)//! The original surface is unchanged — [`PipelineView::new`],
[21](https://docs.rs#21)//! [`with_progress`](PipelineView::with_progress), [`counts`](PipelineView::counts),
[22](https://docs.rs#22)//! [`Status`], [`JobProgress`] all behave as before. The look/animation is
[23](https://docs.rs#23)//! **additive**: themed + animated **on by default**, switch off with
[24](https://docs.rs#24)//! [`with_animation(false)`](PipelineView::with_animation); edge throughput labels
[25](https://docs.rs#25)//! are opt-in via [`with_throughput`](PipelineView::with_throughput).
[26](https://docs.rs#26)
[27](https://docs.rs#27)use egui::{Align2, Color32, FontId, Pos2, Rect, Sense, Stroke, Vec2};
[28](https://docs.rs#28)use facett_core::effects::{easing, glow_rect};
[29](https://docs.rs#29)use facett_core::look::{Action, keymap};
[30](https://docs.rs#30)use facett_core::nav::Navigable;
[31](https://docs.rs#31)use facett_core::{Facet, theme};
[32](https://docs.rs#32)use facett_graph::{DepEdge, DepGraphView, DepNode};
[33](https://docs.rs#33)
[34](https://docs.rs#34)pub mod model;
[35](https://docs.rs#35)pub use model::{
[36](https://docs.rs#36)    PipelineAdapter, PipelineEdge, PipelineMetrics, PipelineModel, Stage, StageMetrics, StageStatus,
[37](https://docs.rs#37)};
[38](https://docs.rs#38)
[39](https://docs.rs#39)/// A dataset/stage run status (generic — map your engine's status to this).
[40](https://docs.rs#40)#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
[41](https://docs.rs#41)pub enum Status {
[42](https://docs.rs#42)    #[default]
[43](https://docs.rs#43)    Idle,
[44](https://docs.rs#44)    Running,
[45](https://docs.rs#45)    Done,
[46](https://docs.rs#46)    Failed,
[47](https://docs.rs#47)}
[48](https://docs.rs#48)
[49](https://docs.rs#49)impl Status {
[50](https://docs.rs#50)    /// A reasonable fixed colour (kept for back-compat / non-themed callers).
[51](https://docs.rs#51)    /// The themed render uses [`theme_color`](Status::theme_color) instead.
[52](https://docs.rs#52)    pub fn color(self) -> Color32 {
[53](https://docs.rs#53)        match self {
[54](https://docs.rs#54)            Status::Done => Color32::from_rgb(80, 180, 120),
[55](https://docs.rs#55)            Status::Running => Color32::from_rgb(80, 140, 220),
[56](https://docs.rs#56)            Status::Failed => Color32::from_rgb(220, 80, 80),
[57](https://docs.rs#57)            Status::Idle => Color32::from_gray(130),
[58](https://docs.rs#58)        }
[59](https://docs.rs#59)    }
[60](https://docs.rs#60)
[61](https://docs.rs#61)    /// The status colour **derived from the active [`Theme`]** — done/running ride
[62](https://docs.rs#62)    /// the palette's `accent`/`point`, failed is a warm red, idle is dimmed text.
[63](https://docs.rs#63)    /// This is what the themed DAG paints with.
[64](https://docs.rs#64)    pub fn theme_color(self, th: &facett_core::Theme) -> Color32 {
[65](https://docs.rs#65)        match self {
[66](https://docs.rs#66)            Status::Done => th.point,
[67](https://docs.rs#67)            Status::Running => th.accent,
[68](https://docs.rs#68)            Status::Failed => Color32::from_rgb(224, 72, 72),
[69](https://docs.rs#69)            Status::Idle => th.text_dim,
[70](https://docs.rs#70)        }
[71](https://docs.rs#71)    }
[72](https://docs.rs#72)
[73](https://docs.rs#73)    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
[74](https://docs.rs#74)        match self {
[75](https://docs.rs#75)            Status::Idle => "idle",
[76](https://docs.rs#76)            Status::Running => "running",
[77](https://docs.rs#77)            Status::Done => "done",
[78](https://docs.rs#78)            Status::Failed => "failed",
[79](https://docs.rs#79)        }
[80](https://docs.rs#80)    }
[81](https://docs.rs#81)}
[82](https://docs.rs#82)
[83](https://docs.rs#83)/// Overall job progress (Spark stages/tasks).
[84](https://docs.rs#84)///
[85](https://docs.rs#85)/// The original three fields (`fraction`/`tasks_done`/`tasks_total`) are
[86](https://docs.rs#86)/// unchanged; the **live-run** fields below are additive (default `0`) so a
[87](https://docs.rs#87)/// consumer can surface real Spark throughput — rows processed, bytes read,
[88](https://docs.rs#88)/// wall-clock elapsed, and a derived rows/sec — not just a task bar. All are
[89](https://docs.rs#89)/// reflected in [`PipelineView::state_json`] for headless assertion.
[90](https://docs.rs#90)#[derive(Clone, Default)]
[91](https://docs.rs#91)pub struct JobProgress {
[92](https://docs.rs#92)    pub fraction: f32,
[93](https://docs.rs#93)    pub tasks_done: u64,
[94](https://docs.rs#94)    pub tasks_total: u64,
[95](https://docs.rs#95)    /// Rows processed so far across the run (additive; `0` = unknown).
[96](https://docs.rs#96)    pub rows: u64,
[97](https://docs.rs#97)    /// Input bytes read so far across the run (additive; `0` = unknown).
[98](https://docs.rs#98)    pub bytes_read: u64,
[99](https://docs.rs#99)    /// Wall-clock seconds elapsed since the run started (additive; `0.0` = n/a).
[100](https://docs.rs#100)    pub elapsed_s: f32,
[101](https://docs.rs#101)    /// Tasks in flight right now (Spark `num_inflight_tasks`; additive).
[102](https://docs.rs#102)    pub inflight: u64,
[103](https://docs.rs#103)}
[104](https://docs.rs#104)
[105](https://docs.rs#105)impl JobProgress {
[106](https://docs.rs#106)    /// Live row throughput in rows/sec, derived from `rows / elapsed_s`. Returns
[107](https://docs.rs#107)    /// `0.0` when elapsed is non-positive (no rate yet). Pure + testable.
[108](https://docs.rs#108)    pub fn rows_per_s(&self) -> f32 {
[109](https://docs.rs#109)        if self.elapsed_s > 0.0 {
[110](https://docs.rs#110)            self.rows as f32 / self.elapsed_s
[111](https://docs.rs#111)        } else {
[112](https://docs.rs#112)            0.0
[113](https://docs.rs#113)        }
[114](https://docs.rs#114)    }
[115](https://docs.rs#115)}
[116](https://docs.rs#116)
[117](https://docs.rs#117)/// One pipeline stage/dataset node: its name + status, plus the optional live
[118](https://docs.rs#118)/// detail a real Spark run surfaces — a sublabel (e.g. the output type
[119](https://docs.rs#119)/// `materialized_view`), rows processed, and — for a [`Status::Failed`] node —
[120](https://docs.rs#120)/// the **error message** to surface. Built from a knut `Dataset` + `NodeStatus`
[121](https://docs.rs#121)/// by the consumer; the component owns no knut dependency.
[122](https://docs.rs#122)#[derive(Clone, Default)]
[123](https://docs.rs#123)pub struct PipelineNode {
[124](https://docs.rs#124)    pub name: String,
[125](https://docs.rs#125)    pub status: Status,
[126](https://docs.rs#126)    /// Secondary line under the name (e.g. the output type). `None` falls back
[127](https://docs.rs#127)    /// to the status label.
[128](https://docs.rs#128)    pub detail: Option<String>,
[129](https://docs.rs#129)    /// Rows this node has materialised/processed (additive; `None` = unknown).
[130](https://docs.rs#130)    pub rows: Option<u64>,
[131](https://docs.rs#131)    /// Error message to surface on a failed node (drawn + emitted in state).
[132](https://docs.rs#132)    pub error: Option<String>,
[133](https://docs.rs#133)    /// Live per-node throughput in rows/sec (additive; `None` = unknown). When set
[134](https://docs.rs#134)    /// it draws under the status sub-label and rides `state_json`. Streaming
[135](https://docs.rs#135)    /// metrics (GAP #3) will populate this; the field + render path exist now.
[136](https://docs.rs#136)    pub throughput_rows_s: Option<f32>,
[137](https://docs.rs#137)    /// Live streaming lag/backlog in seconds (additive; `None` = unknown). Hook
[138](https://docs.rs#138)    /// for GAP #3 (watermark/backlog); rendered + emitted when present.
[139](https://docs.rs#139)    pub lag_s: Option<f32>,
[140](https://docs.rs#140)}
[141](https://docs.rs#141)
[142](https://docs.rs#142)impl PipelineNode {
[143](https://docs.rs#143)    /// A node with just a name + status (matching the old `(name, Status)` pair).
[144](https://docs.rs#144)    pub fn new(name: impl Into<String>, status: Status) -> Self {
[145](https://docs.rs#145)        PipelineNode {
[146](https://docs.rs#146)            name: name.into(),
[147](https://docs.rs#147)            status,
[148](https://docs.rs#148)            detail: None,
[149](https://docs.rs#149)            rows: None,
[150](https://docs.rs#150)            error: None,
[151](https://docs.rs#151)            throughput_rows_s: None,
[152](https://docs.rs#152)            lag_s: None,
[153](https://docs.rs#153)        }
[154](https://docs.rs#154)    }
[155](https://docs.rs#155)    pub fn with_detail(mut self, d: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
[156](https://docs.rs#156)        self.detail = Some(d.into());
[157](https://docs.rs#157)        self
[158](https://docs.rs#158)    }
[159](https://docs.rs#159)    pub fn with_rows(mut self, rows: u64) -> Self {
[160](https://docs.rs#160)        self.rows = Some(rows);
[161](https://docs.rs#161)        self
[162](https://docs.rs#162)    }
[163](https://docs.rs#163)    pub fn with_error(mut self, e: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
[164](https://docs.rs#164)        self.error = Some(e.into());
[165](https://docs.rs#165)        self
[166](https://docs.rs#166)    }
[167](https://docs.rs#167)    /// Attach a live per-node throughput (rows/sec). Drawn under the status line.
[168](https://docs.rs#168)    pub fn with_throughput_rows_s(mut self, r: f32) -> Self {
[169](https://docs.rs#169)        self.throughput_rows_s = Some(r);
[170](https://docs.rs#170)        self
[171](https://docs.rs#171)    }
[172](https://docs.rs#172)    /// Attach a live streaming lag/backlog (seconds). Drawn under the status line.
[173](https://docs.rs#173)    pub fn with_lag_s(mut self, l: f32) -> Self {
[174](https://docs.rs#174)        self.lag_s = Some(l);
[175](https://docs.rs#175)        self
[176](https://docs.rs#176)    }
[177](https://docs.rs#177)}
[178](https://docs.rs#178)
[179](https://docs.rs#179)/// How a single edge animates this frame — the **pure** core of the flowing-edge
[180](https://docs.rs#180)/// effect, so the phase math is unit-testable without a painter.
[181](https://docs.rs#181)#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
[182](https://docs.rs#182)pub struct EdgeFlow {
[183](https://docs.rs#183)    /// Marching-ants phase in `[0,1)`: the fractional offset of the dash pattern
[184](https://docs.rs#184)    /// along the edge, advancing with time × speed in the `from → to` direction.
[185](https://docs.rs#185)    pub phase: f32,
[186](https://docs.rs#186)}
[187](https://docs.rs#187)
[188](https://docs.rs#188)/// The marching-ants **phase** of an edge at wall-clock `time` (seconds) for a
[189](https://docs.rs#189)/// given `speed` (cycles/sec). Pure + deterministic — `phase ∈ [0,1)`, increasing
[190](https://docs.rs#190)/// with time, wrapping each cycle. `speed <= 0` freezes the flow at phase 0.
[191](https://docs.rs#191)pub fn edge_phase(time: f64, speed: f32) -> f32 {
[192](https://docs.rs#192)    if speed <= 0.0 {
[193](https://docs.rs#193)        return 0.0;
[194](https://docs.rs#194)    }
[195](https://docs.rs#195)    (time * speed as f64).rem_euclid(1.0) as f32
[196](https://docs.rs#196)}
[197](https://docs.rs#197)
[198](https://docs.rs#198)/// The per-stage glow **intensity** in `[0,1]` for `status` at `time`. Running
[199](https://docs.rs#199)/// pulses (eased sine), done holds a steady soft glow, failed blooms strongly,
[200](https://docs.rs#200)/// idle doesn't glow. Pure, so the pulse curve is testable.
[201](https://docs.rs#201)pub fn status_glow(status: Status, time: f64, speed: f32) -> f32 {
[202](https://docs.rs#202)    match status {
[203](https://docs.rs#203)        Status::Running => {
[204](https://docs.rs#204)            let raw = ((time * speed.max(0.1) as f64 * 2.0).sin() as f32) * 0.5 + 0.5;
[205](https://docs.rs#205)            0.25 + 0.75 * easing::ease_in_out_cubic(raw)
[206](https://docs.rs#206)        }
[207](https://docs.rs#207)        Status::Done => 0.35,
[208](https://docs.rs#208)        Status::Failed => 0.9,
[209](https://docs.rs#209)        Status::Idle => 0.0,
[210](https://docs.rs#210)    }
[211](https://docs.rs#211)}
[212](https://docs.rs#212)
[213](https://docs.rs#213)/// The pipeline view: a DAG + optional job progress, themed + animated.
[214](https://docs.rs#214)pub struct PipelineView {
[215](https://docs.rs#215)    pub title: String,
[216](https://docs.rs#216)    /// The rich per-node model (name, status, detail, rows, error). The legacy
[217](https://docs.rs#217)    /// `statuses` view is derived from this.
[218](https://docs.rs#218)    nodes: Vec<PipelineNode>,
[219](https://docs.rs#219)    dag: DepGraphView,
[220](https://docs.rs#220)    pub progress: Option<JobProgress>,
[221](https://docs.rs#221)    /// Animate the flowing edges + status glow (on by default).
[222](https://docs.rs#222)    animated: bool,
[223](https://docs.rs#223)    /// Flow speed (marching-ants cycles/sec; also drives the running-pulse).
[224](https://docs.rs#224)    speed: f32,
[225](https://docs.rs#225)    /// Optional per-edge throughput label (e.g. "12k rows/s"), indexed like
[226](https://docs.rs#226)    /// `edges`. Empty/`None` entries draw no label.
[227](https://docs.rs#227)    throughput: Vec<Option<String>>,
[228](https://docs.rs#228)    /// Edge endpoints, in the same order as `dag.edges` (`(from_idx, to_idx)`).
[229](https://docs.rs#229)    /// Kept so the animated painter can resolve flow direction + labels.
[230](https://docs.rs#230)    edge_ends: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
[231](https://docs.rs#231)    /// Name of the click-selected node, for the detail panel. Keyed on the stable
[232](https://docs.rs#232)    /// node **name** (FC-5), not a list index — reordering nodes can't re-point it.
[233](https://docs.rs#233)    selected: Option<String>,
[234](https://docs.rs#234)    /// **Injected animation clock** (seconds; FC-7). The flowing-edge phase + the
[235](https://docs.rs#235)    /// status-glow pulse are a pure function of this, so two renders from the same
[236](https://docs.rs#236)    /// state + clock produce identical frames + AccessKit. Defaults to `None` =
[237](https://docs.rs#237)    /// "follow ambient `ui.input(i.time)`" (real-time UX); a test/host pins it via
[238](https://docs.rs#238)    /// [`set_clock`](Self::set_clock) / [`tick`](Self::tick) for determinism.
[239](https://docs.rs#239)    clock_s: Option<f64>,
[240](https://docs.rs#240)    /// **Shared pan/zoom camera** (`facett_core::nav::Navigable`, GAP #1). The DAG
[241](https://docs.rs#241)    /// is laid out in *scene* coords (the fixed grid math) and painted through
[242](https://docs.rs#242)    /// `nav.to_screen`, so wheel zoom-to-cursor, drag-pan, keyboard pan/zoom and
[243](https://docs.rs#243)    /// fit-to-view all reuse the exact model the OSM 2D viewer drives. Emitted in
[244](https://docs.rs#244)    /// `state_json["nav"]` so navigation is headless-assertable.
[245](https://docs.rs#245)    nav: Navigable,
[246](https://docs.rs#246)    /// One-shot "the host should preview this dataset" request, set when a node is
[247](https://docs.rs#247)    /// click-selected. The host (Korp) drains it via
[248](https://docs.rs#248)    /// [`take_preview_request`](Self::take_preview_request) and fetches the table —
[249](https://docs.rs#249)    /// keeps the component source-agnostic (it owns no data dependency).
[250](https://docs.rs#250)    preview_request: Option<String>,
[251](https://docs.rs#251)    /// Set once the camera has been auto-fit to the DAG for the first paint, so we
[252](https://docs.rs#252)    /// frame the graph on open (like the OSM viewer) without re-fitting every frame.
[253](https://docs.rs#253)    fitted: bool,
[254](https://docs.rs#254)}
[255](https://docs.rs#255)
[256](https://docs.rs#256)const NODE_W: f32 = 160.0;
[257](https://docs.rs#257)const NODE_H: f32 = 56.0;
[258](https://docs.rs#258)const COL_GAP: f32 = 220.0;
[259](https://docs.rs#259)const ROW_GAP: f32 = 90.0;
[260](https://docs.rs#260)const LEFT_PAD: f32 = 30.0;
[261](https://docs.rs#261)const TOP_PAD: f32 = 40.0;
[262](https://docs.rs#262)/// Wheel zoom sensitivity (per smooth-scroll unit) — mirrors the OSM viewer feel.
[263](https://docs.rs#263)const WHEEL_ZOOM_RATE: f32 = 0.0015;
[264](https://docs.rs#264)/// Keyboard pan step in screen px per arrow press.
[265](https://docs.rs#265)const KEY_PAN_PX: f32 = 60.0;
[266](https://docs.rs#266)/// Keyboard zoom factor per +/− / PageUp/Down press.
[267](https://docs.rs#267)const KEY_ZOOM_STEP: f32 = 1.2;
[268](https://docs.rs#268)
[269](https://docs.rs#269)impl PipelineView {
[270](https://docs.rs#270)    /// `nodes` = `(dataset name, status)`; `edges` = `(reads_idx, target_idx)`.
[271](https://docs.rs#271)    /// Back-compat entry point; for the rich model (rows/error/detail) use
[272](https://docs.rs#272)    /// [`from_nodes`](Self::from_nodes).
[273](https://docs.rs#273)    pub fn new(title: impl Into<String>, nodes: Vec<(String, Status)>, edges: Vec<(usize, usize)>) -> Self {
[274](https://docs.rs#274)        let rich = nodes.into_iter().map(|(name, s)| PipelineNode::new(name, s)).collect();
[275](https://docs.rs#275)        Self::from_nodes(title, rich, edges)
[276](https://docs.rs#276)    }
[277](https://docs.rs#277)
[278](https://docs.rs#278)    /// Build from the **rich** node model — each [`PipelineNode`] carrying its
[279](https://docs.rs#279)    /// status plus optional detail/rows/error. This is what a real Spark run maps
[280](https://docs.rs#280)    /// to (a knut `Dataset` + `NodeStatus` + the live stream), so the failed
[281](https://docs.rs#281)    /// node's error and per-node rows reach the view + its `state_json`.
[282](https://docs.rs#282)    pub fn from_nodes(title: impl Into<String>, nodes: Vec<PipelineNode>, edges: Vec<(usize, usize)>) -> Self {
[283](https://docs.rs#283)        let dep_nodes: Vec<DepNode> = nodes
[284](https://docs.rs#284)            .iter()
[285](https://docs.rs#285)            .map(|n| DepNode {
[286](https://docs.rs#286)                label: n.name.clone(),
[287](https://docs.rs#287)                sublabel: Some(n.detail.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| n.status.label().to_string())),
[288](https://docs.rs#288)                color: n.status.color(),
[289](https://docs.rs#289)            })
[290](https://docs.rs#290)            .collect();
[291](https://docs.rs#291)        let edge_ends = edges.clone();
[292](https://docs.rs#292)        let dep_edges: Vec<DepEdge> = edges.into_iter().map(|(f, t)| DepEdge { from: f, to: t, via: vec![] }).collect();
[293](https://docs.rs#293)        Self {
[294](https://docs.rs#294)            title: title.into(),
[295](https://docs.rs#295)            nodes,
[296](https://docs.rs#296)            dag: DepGraphView::new(dep_nodes, dep_edges),
[297](https://docs.rs#297)            progress: None,
[298](https://docs.rs#298)            animated: true,
[299](https://docs.rs#299)            speed: 0.6,
[300](https://docs.rs#300)            throughput: Vec::new(),
[301](https://docs.rs#301)            edge_ends,
[302](https://docs.rs#302)            selected: None,
[303](https://docs.rs#303)            clock_s: None,
[304](https://docs.rs#304)            nav: Navigable::default(),
[305](https://docs.rs#305)            preview_request: None,
[306](https://docs.rs#306)            fitted: false,
[307](https://docs.rs#307)        }
[308](https://docs.rs#308)    }
[309](https://docs.rs#309)
[310](https://docs.rs#310)    /// Build the view from the **engine-agnostic [`PipelineModel`]** — the neutral
[311](https://docs.rs#311)    /// shape any engine's [`PipelineAdapter`] produces. This is the new canonical
[312](https://docs.rs#312)    /// entry point: the viewer is now *renderer-independent of the source engine*.
[313](https://docs.rs#313)    /// Stages → rich nodes (status/kind/error/metrics), the model's id-based
[314](https://docs.rs#314)    /// [`PipelineEdge`]s are resolved to index pairs (unknown ids dropped), edge
[315](https://docs.rs#315)    /// labels become throughput labels, and pipeline metrics → the progress bar.
[316](https://docs.rs#316)    /// The legacy [`new`](Self::new) / [`from_nodes`](Self::from_nodes) builders
[317](https://docs.rs#317)    /// still work and are unchanged.
[318](https://docs.rs#318)    pub fn from_model(model: PipelineModel) -> Self {
[319](https://docs.rs#319)        // Stages → the rich PipelineNode model the painter already renders.
[320](https://docs.rs#320)        let nodes: Vec<PipelineNode> = model
[321](https://docs.rs#321)            .stages
[322](https://docs.rs#322)            .iter()
[323](https://docs.rs#323)            .map(|s| PipelineNode {
[324](https://docs.rs#324)                name: s.name.clone(),
[325](https://docs.rs#325)                status: s.status.into(),
[326](https://docs.rs#326)                detail: s.kind.clone(),
[327](https://docs.rs#327)                rows: s.metrics.rows,
[328](https://docs.rs#328)                error: s.error.clone(),
[329](https://docs.rs#329)                throughput_rows_s: s.metrics.throughput_rows_s,
[330](https://docs.rs#330)                lag_s: s.metrics.lag_s,
[331](https://docs.rs#331)            })
[332](https://docs.rs#332)            .collect();
[333](https://docs.rs#333)
[334](https://docs.rs#334)        // Resolve id-based edges → index pairs in `(reads_idx, target_idx)` form
[335](https://docs.rs#335)        // (the painter's existing edge convention: `from` reads `to`, dataflow
[336](https://docs.rs#336)        // runs to→from). The model's edge is `from → to` source→consumer, so the
[337](https://docs.rs#337)        // painter pair is `(to_idx, from_idx)`. Edges naming an unknown stage id
[338](https://docs.rs#338)        // are dropped (an external upstream outside the rendered graph).
[339](https://docs.rs#339)        let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(model.edges.len());
[340](https://docs.rs#340)        let mut throughput = Vec::with_capacity(model.edges.len());
[341](https://docs.rs#341)        for e in &model.edges {
[342](https://docs.rs#342)            match (model.stage_index(&e.from), model.stage_index(&e.to)) {
[343](https://docs.rs#343)                (Some(from_i), Some(to_i)) => {
[344](https://docs.rs#344)                    edges.push((to_i, from_i));
[345](https://docs.rs#345)                    throughput.push(e.label.clone());
[346](https://docs.rs#346)                }
[347](https://docs.rs#347)                _ => continue,
[348](https://docs.rs#348)            }
[349](https://docs.rs#349)        }
[350](https://docs.rs#350)
[351](https://docs.rs#351)        let mut view = Self::from_nodes(model.title, nodes, edges);
[352](https://docs.rs#352)        if throughput.iter().any(|l| l.is_some()) {
[353](https://docs.rs#353)            view = view.with_throughput(throughput);
[354](https://docs.rs#354)        }
[355](https://docs.rs#355)        if let Some(m) = model.metrics {
[356](https://docs.rs#356)            view = view.with_progress(JobProgress {
[357](https://docs.rs#357)                fraction: m.fraction.unwrap_or_else(|| {
[358](https://docs.rs#358)                    if m.tasks_total > 0 {
[359](https://docs.rs#359)                        m.tasks_done as f32 / m.tasks_total as f32
[360](https://docs.rs#360)                    } else {
[361](https://docs.rs#361)                        0.0
[362](https://docs.rs#362)                    }
[363](https://docs.rs#363)                }),
[364](https://docs.rs#364)                tasks_done: m.tasks_done,
[365](https://docs.rs#365)                tasks_total: m.tasks_total,
[366](https://docs.rs#366)                rows: m.rows,
[367](https://docs.rs#367)                bytes_read: m.bytes_read,
[368](https://docs.rs#368)                elapsed_s: m.elapsed_s,
[369](https://docs.rs#369)                inflight: m.inflight,
[370](https://docs.rs#370)            });
[371](https://docs.rs#371)        }
[372](https://docs.rs#372)        view
[373](https://docs.rs#373)    }
[374](https://docs.rs#374)
[375](https://docs.rs#375)    /// Build the view straight from any [`PipelineAdapter`] — `adapter →
[376](https://docs.rs#376)    /// normalized model → view`. The one call a host makes regardless of engine.
[377](https://docs.rs#377)    pub fn from_adapter(adapter: &impl PipelineAdapter) -> Self {
[378](https://docs.rs#378)        Self::from_model(adapter.to_pipeline_model())
[379](https://docs.rs#379)    }
[380](https://docs.rs#380)
[381](https://docs.rs#381)    /// Pre-select a node by name (drives the detail panel + `selection_json`).
[382](https://docs.rs#382)    /// Unknown names clear the selection. Returns `self` for chaining.
[383](https://docs.rs#383)    pub fn with_selected(mut self, name: &str) -> Self {
[384](https://docs.rs#384)        self.selected = self.nodes.iter().find(|n| n.name == name).map(|n| n.name.clone());
[385](https://docs.rs#385)        self
[386](https://docs.rs#386)    }
[387](https://docs.rs#387)
[388](https://docs.rs#388)    /// **Pin the animation clock** (seconds; FC-7). Once set, the flowing edges +
[389](https://docs.rs#389)    /// status glow are a pure function of this value — identical state + clock ⇒
[390](https://docs.rs#390)    /// identical frame + AccessKit tree. Pass it from an injected/host clock in a
[391](https://docs.rs#391)    /// test to make animation reproducible.
[392](https://docs.rs#392)    pub fn set_clock(&mut self, seconds: f64) {
[393](https://docs.rs#393)        self.clock_s = Some(seconds);
[394](https://docs.rs#394)    }
[395](https://docs.rs#395)
[396](https://docs.rs#396)    /// Advance the injected clock by `dt` seconds (initialising from 0 if unset).
[397](https://docs.rs#397)    /// The host-driven analogue of `Msg::Tick(dt)` — lets a caller step the
[398](https://docs.rs#398)    /// animation deterministically frame by frame.
[399](https://docs.rs#399)    pub fn tick(&mut self, dt: f64) {
[400](https://docs.rs#400)        self.clock_s = Some(self.clock_s.unwrap_or(0.0) + dt);
[401](https://docs.rs#401)    }
[402](https://docs.rs#402)
[403](https://docs.rs#403)    /// Builder form of [`set_clock`](Self::set_clock).
[404](https://docs.rs#404)    pub fn with_clock(mut self, seconds: f64) -> Self {
[405](https://docs.rs#405)        self.clock_s = Some(seconds);
[406](https://docs.rs#406)        self
[407](https://docs.rs#407)    }
[408](https://docs.rs#408)
[409](https://docs.rs#409)    /// **FC-8 quiescence.** `true` when no stage is `Running` and no Spark task is
[410](https://docs.rs#410)    /// in flight — i.e. the view has settled and a caller need not wait. Readable
[411](https://docs.rs#411)    /// without any timing hack (also surfaced in `state_json` as `idle`).
[412](https://docs.rs#412)    pub fn is_idle(&self) -> bool {
[413](https://docs.rs#413)        let any_running = self.nodes.iter().any(|n| n.status == Status::Running);
[414](https://docs.rs#414)        let any_inflight = self.progress.as_ref().is_some_and(|p| p.inflight > 0);
[415](https://docs.rs#415)        !(any_running || any_inflight)
[416](https://docs.rs#416)    }
[417](https://docs.rs#417)    pub fn with_progress(mut self, p: JobProgress) -> Self {
[418](https://docs.rs#418)        self.progress = Some(p);
[419](https://docs.rs#419)        self
[420](https://docs.rs#420)    }
[421](https://docs.rs#421)
[422](https://docs.rs#422)    /// Turn the flowing-edge / status-glow animation on or off (default on). When
[423](https://docs.rs#423)    /// off it renders a still, themed DAG (good for screenshots / headless).
[424](https://docs.rs#424)    pub fn with_animation(mut self, on: bool) -> Self {
[425](https://docs.rs#425)        self.animated = on;
[426](https://docs.rs#426)        self
[427](https://docs.rs#427)    }
[428](https://docs.rs#428)
[429](https://docs.rs#429)    /// Set the flow speed (marching-ants cycles/sec). Clamped non-negative.
[430](https://docs.rs#430)    pub fn with_speed(mut self, speed: f32) -> Self {
[431](https://docs.rs#431)        self.speed = speed.max(0.0);
[432](https://docs.rs#432)        self
[433](https://docs.rs#433)    }
[434](https://docs.rs#434)
[435](https://docs.rs#435)    /// Attach per-edge throughput labels (e.g. `"12k rows/s"`), indexed like the
[436](https://docs.rs#436)    /// `edges` passed to [`new`](Self::new). Shorter/longer vectors are tolerated.
[437](https://docs.rs#437)    pub fn with_throughput(mut self, labels: Vec<Option<String>>) -> Self {
[438](https://docs.rs#438)        self.throughput = labels;
[439](https://docs.rs#439)        self
[440](https://docs.rs#440)    }
[441](https://docs.rs#441)
[442](https://docs.rs#442)    /// (idle, running, done, failed).
[443](https://docs.rs#443)    pub fn counts(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize, usize) {
[444](https://docs.rs#444)        let mut c = (0, 0, 0, 0);
[445](https://docs.rs#445)        for n in &self.nodes {
[446](https://docs.rs#446)            match n.status {
[447](https://docs.rs#447)                Status::Idle => c.0 += 1,
[448](https://docs.rs#448)                Status::Running => c.1 += 1,
[449](https://docs.rs#449)                Status::Done => c.2 += 1,
[450](https://docs.rs#450)                Status::Failed => c.3 += 1,
[451](https://docs.rs#451)            }
[452](https://docs.rs#452)        }
[453](https://docs.rs#453)        c
[454](https://docs.rs#454)    }
[455](https://docs.rs#455)
[456](https://docs.rs#456)    /// **Test/host hook (additive).** The public, return-asserted view of the
[457](https://docs.rs#457)    /// private [`layout_scene`](Self::layout_scene) — the toposort-column scene
[458](https://docs.rs#458)    /// centres the DAG painter places each stage box at (before the camera maps
[459](https://docs.rs#459)    /// them to screen). Exposed so the pipeline call-chain matrix can assert the
[460](https://docs.rs#460)    /// *layout/columns* stage directly: finite, x monotone-non-decreasing with the
[461](https://docs.rs#461)    /// toposort column, rows separated, count == nodes. Calls the **same** private
[462](https://docs.rs#462)    /// fn the painter uses — additive, no behaviour change.
[463](https://docs.rs#463)    pub fn layout_scene_centers(&self) -> Vec<Pos2> {
[464](https://docs.rs#464)        self.layout_scene()
[465](https://docs.rs#465)    }
[466](https://docs.rs#466)
[467](https://docs.rs#467)    /// Node centres in **scene** coords (the fixed-grid toposort layout, origin at
[468](https://docs.rs#468)    /// 0,0). The painter maps these through [`Navigable::to_screen`] so the whole
[469](https://docs.rs#469)    /// DAG pans/zooms as one. Scene-space is stable across frames — independent of
[470](https://docs.rs#470)    /// the allocated `rect` — which is what makes the camera coherent.
[471](https://docs.rs#471)    fn layout_scene(&self) -> Vec<Pos2> {
[472](https://docs.rs#472)        let col = self.dag.columns();
[473](https://docs.rs#473)        let n = self.nodes.len();
[474](https://docs.rs#474)        let mut row_of = vec![0usize; n];
[475](https://docs.rs#475)        let mut per_col: std::collections::BTreeMap<usize, usize> = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
[476](https://docs.rs#476)        for (i, &c) in col.iter().enumerate() {
[477](https://docs.rs#477)            let r = per_col.entry(c).or_insert(0);
[478](https://docs.rs#478)            row_of[i] = *r;
[479](https://docs.rs#479)            *r += 1;
[480](https://docs.rs#480)        }
[481](https://docs.rs#481)        (0..n)
[482](https://docs.rs#482)            .map(|i| {
[483](https://docs.rs#483)                Pos2::new(
[484](https://docs.rs#484)                    LEFT_PAD + col.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0) as f32 * COL_GAP + NODE_W / 2.0,
[485](https://docs.rs#485)                    TOP_PAD + row_of[i] as f32 * ROW_GAP + NODE_H / 2.0,
[486](https://docs.rs#486)                )
[487](https://docs.rs#487)            })
[488](https://docs.rs#488)            .collect()
[489](https://docs.rs#489)    }
[490](https://docs.rs#490)
[491](https://docs.rs#491)    /// The scene-space bounding box enclosing every node box (with a small margin),
[492](https://docs.rs#492)    /// used by fit-to-view. `None` when there are no nodes.
[493](https://docs.rs#493)    fn scene_bbox(&self) -> Option<Rect> {
[494](https://docs.rs#494)        let centers = self.layout_scene();
[495](https://docs.rs#495)        if centers.is_empty() {
[496](https://docs.rs#496)            return None;
[497](https://docs.rs#497)        }
[498](https://docs.rs#498)        let mut bb = Rect::from_center_size(centers[0], Vec2::new(NODE_W, NODE_H));
[499](https://docs.rs#499)        for c in ¢ers[1..] {
[500](https://docs.rs#500)            bb = bb.union(Rect::from_center_size(*c, Vec2::new(NODE_W, NODE_H)));
[501](https://docs.rs#501)        }
[502](https://docs.rs#502)        Some(bb.expand(NODE_W * 0.25))
[503](https://docs.rs#503)    }
[504](https://docs.rs#504)
[505](https://docs.rs#505)    /// Drive the camera from this frame's input (wheel zoom-to-cursor, trackpad
[506](https://docs.rs#506)    /// pinch + pan, drag-pan, keyboard pan/zoom, `F`/Ctrl-0 fit). Mirrors the OSM
[507](https://docs.rs#507)    /// 2D viewer's `handle_input` so the pipeline DAG feels identical (NAV-2).
[508](https://docs.rs#508)    fn handle_nav_input(&mut self, ui: &mut egui::Ui, rect: Rect, resp: &egui::Response) {
[509](https://docs.rs#509)        // ── click-drag pan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
[510](https://docs.rs#510)        if resp.dragged() {
[511](https://docs.rs#511)            self.nav.pan(resp.drag_delta());
[512](https://docs.rs#512)        }
[513](https://docs.rs#513)        // ── pointer: wheel zoom-to-cursor + trackpad pinch + two-finger pan ────
[514](https://docs.rs#514)        let pointer = ui.input(|i| i.pointer.hover_pos()).unwrap_or(rect.center());
[515](https://docs.rs#515)        let anchor = if rect.contains(pointer) { pointer } else { rect.center() };
[516](https://docs.rs#516)        let (scroll, zoom_delta, modifiers) =
[517](https://docs.rs#517)            ui.input(|i| (i.smooth_scroll_delta, i.zoom_delta(), i.modifiers));
[518](https://docs.rs#518)        if resp.hovered() {
[519](https://docs.rs#519)            if (zoom_delta - 1.0).abs() > 1e-4 {
[520](https://docs.rs#520)                self.nav.zoom_to(zoom_delta, anchor);
[521](https://docs.rs#521)            } else if scroll.y.abs() > 0.0 && !modifiers.ctrl {
[522](https://docs.rs#522)                let k = (1.0 + scroll.y * WHEEL_ZOOM_RATE).clamp(0.5, 2.0);
[523](https://docs.rs#523)                self.nav.zoom_to(k, anchor);
[524](https://docs.rs#524)            }
[525](https://docs.rs#525)            if scroll.x.abs() > 0.0 {
[526](https://docs.rs#526)                self.nav.pan(Vec2::new(scroll.x, 0.0));
[527](https://docs.rs#527)            }
[528](https://docs.rs#528)        }
[529](https://docs.rs#529)        // ── keyboard: pan (arrows) & zoom (Cmd/Ctrl-+/−, PageUp/Down) & fit ────
[530](https://docs.rs#530)        let km = keymap(ui);
[531](https://docs.rs#531)        let mut d = Vec2::ZERO;
[532](https://docs.rs#532)        if km.consume(Action::Left, ui) {
[533](https://docs.rs#533)            d.x += KEY_PAN_PX;
[534](https://docs.rs#534)        }
[535](https://docs.rs#535)        if km.consume(Action::Right, ui) {
[536](https://docs.rs#536)            d.x -= KEY_PAN_PX;
[537](https://docs.rs#537)        }
[538](https://docs.rs#538)        if km.consume(Action::Up, ui) {
[539](https://docs.rs#539)            d.y += KEY_PAN_PX;
[540](https://docs.rs#540)        }
[541](https://docs.rs#541)        if km.consume(Action::Down, ui) {
[542](https://docs.rs#542)            d.y -= KEY_PAN_PX;
[543](https://docs.rs#543)        }
[544](https://docs.rs#544)        if d != Vec2::ZERO {
[545](https://docs.rs#545)            self.nav.pan(d);
[546](https://docs.rs#546)        }
[547](https://docs.rs#547)        if km.consume(Action::ZoomIn, ui) || km.consume(Action::PageUp, ui) {
[548](https://docs.rs#548)            self.nav.zoom_to(KEY_ZOOM_STEP, rect.center());
[549](https://docs.rs#549)        }
[550](https://docs.rs#550)        if km.consume(Action::ZoomOut, ui) || km.consume(Action::PageDown, ui) {
[551](https://docs.rs#551)            self.nav.zoom_to(1.0 / KEY_ZOOM_STEP, rect.center());
[552](https://docs.rs#552)        }
[553](https://docs.rs#553)        // Fit: Cmd/Ctrl-0 (FitToView) OR a bare `F` (the "frame the data" map
[554](https://docs.rs#554)        // convention; the semantic keymap binds `F` to Find, so read it raw).
[555](https://docs.rs#555)        let fit = km.consume(Action::FitToView, ui) || ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(egui::Key::F));
[556](https://docs.rs#556)        if fit {
[557](https://docs.rs#557)            self.fit_to(rect);
[558](https://docs.rs#558)        }
[559](https://docs.rs#559)    }
[560](https://docs.rs#560)
[561](https://docs.rs#561)    /// Force-fit the camera to the DAG within `rect` (exposed for hosts + tests).
[562](https://docs.rs#562)    pub fn fit_to(&mut self, rect: Rect) {
[563](https://docs.rs#563)        if let Some(bb) = self.scene_bbox() {
[564](https://docs.rs#564)            self.nav.fit(bb, rect, 0.08);
[565](https://docs.rs#565)            self.fitted = true;
[566](https://docs.rs#566)        }
[567](https://docs.rs#567)    }
[568](https://docs.rs#568)
[569](https://docs.rs#569)    /// Wheel-zoom to a screen anchor by factor `k` (exposed for headless tests).
[570](https://docs.rs#570)    pub fn zoom_to_cursor(&mut self, k: f32, anchor: Pos2) {
[571](https://docs.rs#571)        self.nav.zoom_to(k, anchor);
[572](https://docs.rs#572)    }
[573](https://docs.rs#573)
[574](https://docs.rs#574)    /// Pan the camera by a screen-pixel delta (exposed for headless tests).
[575](https://docs.rs#575)    pub fn pan_pixels(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
[576](https://docs.rs#576)        self.nav.pan(Vec2::new(dx, dy));
[577](https://docs.rs#577)    }
[578](https://docs.rs#578)
[579](https://docs.rs#579)    /// Read-only view of the camera (scale + offset) — the headless nav surface.
[580](https://docs.rs#580)    pub fn nav(&self) -> &Navigable {
[581](https://docs.rs#581)        &self.nav
[582](https://docs.rs#582)    }
[583](https://docs.rs#583)
[584](https://docs.rs#584)    /// **Restore** a camera (and its fitted state) onto a freshly-built view. A
[585](https://docs.rs#585)    /// host that rebuilds the `PipelineView` each frame from changing data (e.g.
[586](https://docs.rs#586)    /// Korp's live stream) calls this so pan/zoom **persists** across rebuilds —
[587](https://docs.rs#587)    /// otherwise the camera would snap back to a fresh fit every frame.
[588](https://docs.rs#588)    pub fn set_camera(&mut self, nav: Navigable, fitted: bool) {
[589](https://docs.rs#589)        self.nav = nav;
[590](https://docs.rs#590)        self.fitted = fitted;
[591](https://docs.rs#591)    }
[592](https://docs.rs#592)
[593](https://docs.rs#593)    /// Whether the camera has been fit to the DAG yet (host carries this across
[594](https://docs.rs#594)    /// rebuilds together with [`nav`](Self::nav) / [`set_camera`](Self::set_camera)).
[595](https://docs.rs#595)    pub fn is_fitted(&self) -> bool {
[596](https://docs.rs#596)        self.fitted
[597](https://docs.rs#597)    }
[598](https://docs.rs#598)
[599](https://docs.rs#599)    /// Count of node boxes whose scene rect (mapped to screen) intersects `rect` —
[600](https://docs.rs#600)    /// the honest "visible nodes" number after pan/zoom. The analogue of the OSM
[601](https://docs.rs#601)    /// viewer's `visible_point_count`, so a test can assert culling by camera.
[602](https://docs.rs#602)    pub fn visible_node_count(&self, rect: Rect) -> usize {
[603](https://docs.rs#603)        let centers = self.layout_scene();
[604](https://docs.rs#604)        centers
[605](https://docs.rs#605)            .iter()
[606](https://docs.rs#606)            .filter(|&&c| {
[607](https://docs.rs#607)                let screen_c = self.nav.to_screen(c);
[608](https://docs.rs#608)                let half = Vec2::new(NODE_W, NODE_H) * 0.5 * self.nav.scale;
[609](https://docs.rs#609)                let nrect = Rect::from_center_size(screen_c, half * 2.0);
[610](https://docs.rs#610)                rect.intersects(nrect)
[611](https://docs.rs#611)            })
[612](https://docs.rs#612)            .count()
[613](https://docs.rs#613)    }
[614](https://docs.rs#614)
[615](https://docs.rs#615)    /// The currently click-selected node name, if any (read each frame by a host
[616](https://docs.rs#616)    /// to drive a preview pane). Part of the discovery contract.
[617](https://docs.rs#617)    pub fn selected(&self) -> Option<&str> {
[618](https://docs.rs#618)        self.selected.as_deref()
[619](https://docs.rs#619)    }
[620](https://docs.rs#620)
[621](https://docs.rs#621)    /// **Drain** the one-shot preview request: returns the dataset name the user
[622](https://docs.rs#622)    /// just clicked (once), so the host can fetch a table preview. `None` until the
[623](https://docs.rs#623)    /// next click. Keeps the component free of any data-fetch dependency.
[624](https://docs.rs#624)    pub fn take_preview_request(&mut self) -> Option<String> {
[625](https://docs.rs#625)        self.preview_request.take()
[626](https://docs.rs#626)    }
[627](https://docs.rs#627)
[628](https://docs.rs#628)    /// The themed + animated DAG paint, **navigable** (GAP #1): nodes are laid out
[629](https://docs.rs#629)    /// in scene coords and mapped through [`Navigable::to_screen`], so wheel
[630](https://docs.rs#630)    /// zoom-to-cursor, drag-pan, keyboard pan/zoom and fit-to-view move the whole
[631](https://docs.rs#631)    /// graph as one. The grid is reused only as the *scene* layout; the camera
[632](https://docs.rs#632)    /// frames it. Reuses `DepGraphView`'s column toposort for placement.
[633](https://docs.rs#633)    fn paint_dag(&mut self, ui: &mut egui::Ui, time: f64) {
[634](https://docs.rs#634)        let n = self.nodes.len();
[635](https://docs.rs#635)        if n == 0 {
[636](https://docs.rs#636)            ui.label("no stages");
[637](https://docs.rs#637)            return;
[638](https://docs.rs#638)        }
[639](https://docs.rs#639)        let th = theme(ui);
[640](https://docs.rs#640)        // Take the whole available area as the navigable canvas (the camera, not
[641](https://docs.rs#641)        // the layout, decides what's on screen now).
[642](https://docs.rs#642)        let avail = ui.available_size();
[643](https://docs.rs#643)        let canvas = Vec2::new(avail.x.max(120.0), avail.y.max(320.0));
[644](https://docs.rs#644)        let (rect, resp) = ui.allocate_exact_size(canvas, Sense::click_and_drag());
[645](https://docs.rs#645)
[646](https://docs.rs#646)        // First paint: frame the DAG to the real pane rect (deferred fit, like OSM).
[647](https://docs.rs#647)        if !self.fitted {
[648](https://docs.rs#648)            self.fit_to(rect);
[649](https://docs.rs#649)        }
[650](https://docs.rs#650)        // Route this frame's pan/zoom/keyboard/fit input into the camera.
[651](https://docs.rs#651)        self.handle_nav_input(ui, rect, &resp);
[652](https://docs.rs#652)
[653](https://docs.rs#653)        let scale = self.nav.scale;
[654](https://docs.rs#654)        let painter = ui.painter_at(rect);
[655](https://docs.rs#655)        painter.rect_filled(rect, egui::CornerRadius::ZERO, th.bg);
[656](https://docs.rs#656)
[657](https://docs.rs#657)        // Scene centres → screen centres through the shared camera.
[658](https://docs.rs#658)        let scene = self.layout_scene();
[659](https://docs.rs#659)        let centers: Vec<Pos2> = scene.iter().map(|&c| self.nav.to_screen(c)).collect();
[660](https://docs.rs#660)        let nsize = Vec2::new(NODE_W, NODE_H) * scale;
[661](https://docs.rs#661)        let phase = if self.animated { edge_phase(time, self.speed) } else { 0.0 };
[662](https://docs.rs#662)
[663](https://docs.rs#663)        // ── edges: themed line + animated marching-ants overlay + throughput ──
[664](https://docs.rs#664)        for (ei, &(from_i, to_i)) in self.edge_ends.iter().enumerate() {
[665](https://docs.rs#665)            if from_i >= n || to_i >= n {
[666](https://docs.rs#666)                continue;
[667](https://docs.rs#667)            }
[668](https://docs.rs#668)            // `from` reads `to`: dataflow runs to → from (source → consumer).
[669](https://docs.rs#669)            let src = centers[to_i];
[670](https://docs.rs#670)            let dst = centers[from_i];
[671](https://docs.rs#671)            paint_flow_edge(&painter, src, dst, th.edge, th.accent, phase, self.animated, scale);
[672](https://docs.rs#672)
[673](https://docs.rs#673)            if let Some(Some(label)) = self.throughput.get(ei) {
[674](https://docs.rs#674)                let mid = Pos2::new((src.x + dst.x) / 2.0, (src.y + dst.y) / 2.0 - 9.0 * scale);
[675](https://docs.rs#675)                painter.text(mid, Align2::CENTER_BOTTOM, label, FontId::monospace(10.0 * scale), th.text_dim);
[676](https://docs.rs#676)            }
[677](https://docs.rs#677)        }
[678](https://docs.rs#678)
[679](https://docs.rs#679)        // ── nodes: themed box + per-status glow + rows + selection ring ──
[680](https://docs.rs#680)        // The painter draws the visual; per node we also ride a hit-testable,
[681](https://docs.rs#681)        // labelled AccessKit node keyed on the **stable node name** (FC-4 + FC-5)
[682](https://docs.rs#682)        // so a robot driver / screen reader can find & click each stage by label.
[683](https://docs.rs#683)        // The AccessKit/hit rect is the **screen-space** (post-camera) box, so
[684](https://docs.rs#684)        // clicks land on what the user sees regardless of pan/zoom.
[685](https://docs.rs#685)        let base_id = ui.id().with("pipeline-nodes");
[686](https://docs.rs#686)        let mut click_select: Option<String> = None;
[687](https://docs.rs#687)        for (i, node) in self.nodes.iter().enumerate() {
[688](https://docs.rs#688)            let status = node.status;
[689](https://docs.rs#689)            let c = centers[i];
[690](https://docs.rs#690)            let nrect = Rect::from_center_size(c, nsize);
[691](https://docs.rs#691)            // Cull boxes fully outside the pane (cheap; keeps big DAGs fast).
[692](https://docs.rs#692)            if !rect.intersects(nrect.expand(40.0 * scale)) {
[693](https://docs.rs#693)                continue;
[694](https://docs.rs#694)            }
[695](https://docs.rs#695)            let sc = status.theme_color(&th);
[696](https://docs.rs#696)
[697](https://docs.rs#697)            // Per-node AccessKit node: role=Button, label "{name} · {status} · N rows",
[698](https://docs.rs#698)            // value = rows, selected = is-this-the-picked-node. Click selects it.
[699](https://docs.rs#699)            let rows_txt = node.rows.map(|r| format!(" · {} rows", human_count(r))).unwrap_or_default();
[700](https://docs.rs#700)            let a11y_label = format!("{} · {}{}", node.name, status.label(), rows_txt);
[701](https://docs.rs#701)            let mut sem = facett_core::a11y::Semantics::button(a11y_label)
[702](https://docs.rs#702)                .selected(self.selected.as_deref() == Some(node.name.as_str()));
[703](https://docs.rs#703)            if let Some(r) = node.rows {
[704](https://docs.rs#704)                sem = sem.value(r as f64);
[705](https://docs.rs#705)            }
[706](https://docs.rs#706)            let resp = facett_core::a11y::node(ui, base_id, &node.name, Sense::click(), nrect, sem);
[707](https://docs.rs#707)            if resp.clicked() {
[708](https://docs.rs#708)                click_select = Some(node.name.clone());
[709](https://docs.rs#709)            }
[710](https://docs.rs#710)            let is_selected = self.selected.as_deref() == Some(node.name.as_str());
[711](https://docs.rs#711)
[712](https://docs.rs#712)            // Status glow underlay (failed blooms, running pulses, done steady).
[713](https://docs.rs#713)            let intensity = if self.animated {
[714](https://docs.rs#714)                status_glow(status, time, self.speed)
[715](https://docs.rs#715)            } else {
[716](https://docs.rs#716)                // Static look: a soft steady glow for the non-idle states.
[717](https://docs.rs#717)                match status {
[718](https://docs.rs#718)                    Status::Idle => 0.0,
[719](https://docs.rs#719)                    Status::Failed => 0.7,
[720](https://docs.rs#720)                    _ => 0.3,
[721](https://docs.rs#721)                }
[722](https://docs.rs#722)            };
[723](https://docs.rs#723)            if intensity > 0.0 {
[724](https://docs.rs#724)                let glow = if status == Status::Failed { Color32::from_rgb(224, 72, 72) } else { sc };
[725](https://docs.rs#725)                glow_rect(&painter, nrect, glow, intensity, ((6.0 * scale).round() as u32).clamp(1, 12));
[726](https://docs.rs#726)            }
[727](https://docs.rs#727)
[728](https://docs.rs#728)            let cr = egui::CornerRadius::same((6.0 * scale).round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8);
[729](https://docs.rs#729)            painter.rect_filled(nrect, cr, th.node_fill);
[730](https://docs.rs#730)            let border = if is_selected { 3.0 } else { 2.0 } * scale.clamp(0.4, 2.0);
[731](https://docs.rs#731)            painter.rect_stroke(nrect, cr, Stroke::new(border, sc), egui::StrokeKind::Inside);
[732](https://docs.rs#732)            // selection ring so the picked node reads clearly.
[733](https://docs.rs#733)            if is_selected {
[734](https://docs.rs#734)                painter.rect_stroke(
[735](https://docs.rs#735)                    nrect.expand(3.0 * scale),
[736](https://docs.rs#736)                    egui::CornerRadius::same((8.0 * scale).round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8),
[737](https://docs.rs#737)                    Stroke::new(1.0, th.accent),
[738](https://docs.rs#738)                    egui::StrokeKind::Outside,
[739](https://docs.rs#739)                );
[740](https://docs.rs#740)            }
[741](https://docs.rs#741)            painter.text(c - Vec2::new(0.0, 12.0 * scale), Align2::CENTER_CENTER, &node.name, FontId::proportional(15.0 * scale), th.text);
[742](https://docs.rs#742)            // Status label, plus the rows count when the run reported it, plus live
[743](https://docs.rs#743)            // per-node throughput/lag when the stream surfaced them (GAP #2/#3 hook).
[744](https://docs.rs#744)            let mut sub = match node.rows {
[745](https://docs.rs#745)                Some(r) => format!("{}  ·  {} rows", status.label(), human_count(r)),
[746](https://docs.rs#746)                None => status.label().to_string(),
[747](https://docs.rs#747)            };
[748](https://docs.rs#748)            if let Some(t) = node.throughput_rows_s {
[749](https://docs.rs#749)                sub.push_str(&format!("  ·  {:.0} rows/s", t));
[750](https://docs.rs#750)            }
[751](https://docs.rs#751)            if let Some(l) = node.lag_s {
[752](https://docs.rs#752)                sub.push_str(&format!("  ·  {:.1}s lag", l));
[753](https://docs.rs#753)            }
[754](https://docs.rs#754)            painter.text(c + Vec2::new(0.0, 11.0 * scale), Align2::CENTER_CENTER, sub, FontId::monospace(11.0 * scale), sc);
[755](https://docs.rs#755)            // A failed node shows a ⚠ corner marker; the message goes to the detail panel.
[756](https://docs.rs#756)            if status == Status::Failed {
[757](https://docs.rs#757)                painter.text(
[758](https://docs.rs#758)                    nrect.right_top() + Vec2::new(-9.0 * scale, 9.0 * scale),
[759](https://docs.rs#759)                    Align2::CENTER_CENTER,
[760](https://docs.rs#760)                    "⚠",
[761](https://docs.rs#761)                    FontId::proportional(13.0 * scale),
[762](https://docs.rs#762)                    Color32::from_rgb(224, 72, 72),
[763](https://docs.rs#763)                );
[764](https://docs.rs#764)            }
[765](https://docs.rs#765)        }
[766](https://docs.rs#766)
[767](https://docs.rs#767)        // Apply a click-to-select after the paint loop (kept out of the borrow). A
[768](https://docs.rs#768)        // fresh click also raises a one-shot preview request the host can drain.
[769](https://docs.rs#769)        if let Some(name) = click_select {
[770](https://docs.rs#770)            self.selected = Some(name.clone());
[771](https://docs.rs#771)            self.preview_request = Some(name);
[772](https://docs.rs#772)        }
[773](https://docs.rs#773)
[774](https://docs.rs#774)        // Keep the animation ticking — only when following the ambient clock. With
[775](https://docs.rs#775)        // an injected clock (`clock_s`), the host steps frames, so we don't spin.
[776](https://docs.rs#776)        if self.animated && self.clock_s.is_none() {
[777](https://docs.rs#777)            ui.ctx().request_repaint();
[778](https://docs.rs#778)        }
[779](https://docs.rs#779)    }
[780](https://docs.rs#780)}
[781](https://docs.rs#781)
[782](https://docs.rs#782)/// Paint one dataflow edge from `src` to `dst`: a faint themed base line, then —
[783](https://docs.rs#783)/// when `animated` — a sequence of bright dashes marching from src→dst at the
[784](https://docs.rs#784)/// given `phase`, plus an arrowhead at `dst`. The marching dashes read as flow
[785](https://docs.rs#785)/// **direction**.
[786](https://docs.rs#786)fn paint_flow_edge(painter: &egui::Painter, src: Pos2, dst: Pos2, base: Color32, flow: Color32, phase: f32, animated: bool, scale: f32) {
[787](https://docs.rs#787)    let seg = dst - src;
[788](https://docs.rs#788)    let len = seg.length().max(1.0);
[789](https://docs.rs#789)    let dir = seg / len;
[790](https://docs.rs#790)    // Pull the visible span back so it meets node edges, not centres. Scaled with
[791](https://docs.rs#791)    // the camera so the edge meets the (scaled) node box at any zoom.
[792](https://docs.rs#792)    let pad = (NODE_W / 2.0 + 6.0) * scale;
[793](https://docs.rs#793)    let a = src + dir * pad.min(len * 0.4);
[794](https://docs.rs#794)    let b = dst - dir * pad.min(len * 0.4);
[795](https://docs.rs#795)    painter.line_segment([a, b], Stroke::new(1.5 * scale, base));
[796](https://docs.rs#796)
[797](https://docs.rs#797)    if animated {
[798](https://docs.rs#798)        // Marching dashes along [a,b]: dash length + gap in px, offset by phase.
[799](https://docs.rs#799)        let span = (b - a).length().max(1.0);
[800](https://docs.rs#800)        let period = 22.0 * scale; // px per dash+gap cycle
[801](https://docs.rs#801)        let dash = 11.0 * scale;
[802](https://docs.rs#802)        let off = phase * period; // 0..period
[803](https://docs.rs#803)        let mut t = -period + off;
[804](https://docs.rs#804)        while t < span {
[805](https://docs.rs#805)            let s = t.max(0.0);
[806](https://docs.rs#806)            let e = (t + dash).min(span);
[807](https://docs.rs#807)            if e > s {
[808](https://docs.rs#808)                let p0 = a + dir * s;
[809](https://docs.rs#809)                let p1 = a + dir * e;
[810](https://docs.rs#810)                painter.line_segment([p0, p1], Stroke::new(2.5 * scale, flow));
[811](https://docs.rs#811)            }
[812](https://docs.rs#812)            t += period;
[813](https://docs.rs#813)        }
[814](https://docs.rs#814)    }
[815](https://docs.rs#815)
[816](https://docs.rs#816)    // Arrowhead at the consumer end.
[817](https://docs.rs#817)    let perp = Vec2::new(-dir.y, dir.x);
[818](https://docs.rs#818)    let tip = b;
[819](https://docs.rs#819)    let backc = tip - dir * 10.0 * scale;
[820](https://docs.rs#820)    let head_color = if animated { flow } else { base };
[821](https://docs.rs#821)    painter.add(egui::Shape::convex_polygon(
[822](https://docs.rs#822)        vec![tip, backc + perp * 5.0 * scale, backc - perp * 5.0 * scale],
[823](https://docs.rs#823)        head_color,
[824](https://docs.rs#824)        Stroke::NONE,
[825](https://docs.rs#825)    ));
[826](https://docs.rs#826)}
[827](https://docs.rs#827)
[828](https://docs.rs#828)impl PipelineView {
[829](https://docs.rs#829)    /// The copyable text: the selected node's line (`name status rows err`) when a
[830](https://docs.rs#830)    /// node is selected, else the whole node list as a TSV rectangle.
[831](https://docs.rs#831)    pub fn copy_text(&self) -> Option<String> {
[832](https://docs.rs#832)        if self.nodes.is_empty() {
[833](https://docs.rs#833)            return None;
[834](https://docs.rs#834)        }
[835](https://docs.rs#835)        let line = |n: &PipelineNode| {
[836](https://docs.rs#836)            format!(
[837](https://docs.rs#837)                "{}\t{}\t{}\t{}",
[838](https://docs.rs#838)                n.name,
[839](https://docs.rs#839)                n.status.label(),
[840](https://docs.rs#840)                n.rows.map(|r| r.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
[841](https://docs.rs#841)                n.error.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
[842](https://docs.rs#842)            )
[843](https://docs.rs#843)        };
[844](https://docs.rs#844)        if let Some(sel) = self.selected.as_deref().and_then(|name| self.nodes.iter().find(|n| n.name == name)) {
[845](https://docs.rs#845)            return Some(line(sel));
[846](https://docs.rs#846)        }
[847](https://docs.rs#847)        let mut out = String::from("name\tstatus\trows\terror");
[848](https://docs.rs#848)        for n in &self.nodes {
[849](https://docs.rs#849)            out.push('\n');
[850](https://docs.rs#850)            out.push_str(&line(n));
[851](https://docs.rs#851)        }
[852](https://docs.rs#852)        Some(out)
[853](https://docs.rs#853)    }
[854](https://docs.rs#854)}
[855](https://docs.rs#855)
[856](https://docs.rs#856)// ── typed copy (§16) — read-only: selected node or the whole DAG as rows ───────
[857](https://docs.rs#857)impl facett_core::clip::CopySource for PipelineView {
[858](https://docs.rs#858)    fn copy_kinds(&self) -> &[facett_core::clip::ClipKind] {
[859](https://docs.rs#859)        use facett_core::clip::ClipKind;
[860](https://docs.rs#860)        &[ClipKind::Rows, ClipKind::Text]
[861](https://docs.rs#861)    }
[862](https://docs.rs#862)
[863](https://docs.rs#863)    fn copy_payload(&self) -> Option<facett_core::clip::ClipPayload> {
[864](https://docs.rs#864)        self.copy_text().map(facett_core::clip::ClipPayload::Rows)
[865](https://docs.rs#865)    }
[866](https://docs.rs#866)}
[867](https://docs.rs#867)
[868](https://docs.rs#868)impl Facet for PipelineView {
[869](https://docs.rs#869)    fn title(&self) -> &str {
[870](https://docs.rs#870)        &self.title
[871](https://docs.rs#871)    }
[872](https://docs.rs#872)    fn copy(&mut self) -> Option<String> {
[873](https://docs.rs#873)        use facett_core::clip::CopySource as _;
[874](https://docs.rs#874)        self.copy_payload().map(|p| p.as_text())
[875](https://docs.rs#875)    }
[876](https://docs.rs#876)    fn caps(&self) -> facett_core::FacetCaps {
[877](https://docs.rs#877)        // Reads the Theme, tolerates host resizing, a node is click-selectable, the
[878](https://docs.rs#878)        // DAG pans/zooms/fits via the shared `Navigable` camera (GAP #1), and the
[879](https://docs.rs#879)        // selection/graph is copyable.
[880](https://docs.rs#880)        facett_core::FacetCaps::NONE.themeable().resizable().selectable().navigable().copyable()
[881](https://docs.rs#881)    }
[882](https://docs.rs#882)    fn ui(&mut self, ui: &mut egui::Ui) {
[883](https://docs.rs#883)        let th = theme(ui);
[884](https://docs.rs#884)        let (idle, running, done, failed) = self.counts();
[885](https://docs.rs#885)        // Themed status legend.
[886](https://docs.rs#886)        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
[887](https://docs.rs#887)            let chip = |ui: &mut egui::Ui, n: usize, s: Status| {
[888](https://docs.rs#888)                ui.colored_label(s.theme_color(&th), format!("● {n} {}", s.label()));
[889](https://docs.rs#889)            };
[890](https://docs.rs#890)            chip(ui, done, Status::Done);
[891](https://docs.rs#891)            chip(ui, running, Status::Running);
[892](https://docs.rs#892)            chip(ui, failed, Status::Failed);
[893](https://docs.rs#893)            chip(ui, idle, Status::Idle);
[894](https://docs.rs#894)            // Navigation affordance + hint (GAP #1): a fit button + the gestures,
[895](https://docs.rs#895)            // so the camera is discoverable and CLI/keyboard parity is advertised.
[896](https://docs.rs#896)            ui.separator();
[897](https://docs.rs#897)            if ui.button("⤢ Fit").on_hover_text("Frame the whole DAG (F / Ctrl-0)").clicked() {
[898](https://docs.rs#898)                self.fitted = false; // refit on the next paint, once we know the rect
[899](https://docs.rs#899)            }
[900](https://docs.rs#900)            ui.label(
[901](https://docs.rs#901)                egui::RichText::new(format!("zoom {:.2}×  ·  wheel zoom · drag pan · arrows · F fit", self.nav.scale))
[902](https://docs.rs#902)                    .small()
[903](https://docs.rs#903)                    .color(th.text_dim),
[904](https://docs.rs#904)            );
[905](https://docs.rs#905)        });
[906](https://docs.rs#906)        if let Some(p) = &self.progress {
[907](https://docs.rs#907)            ui.add(egui::ProgressBar::new(p.fraction).text(format!("{} / {} tasks", p.tasks_done, p.tasks_total)));
[908](https://docs.rs#908)            // Live-run readout: throughput · rows · bytes · elapsed (only the
[909](https://docs.rs#909)            // parts the run actually reported).
[910](https://docs.rs#910)            let mut bits: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
[911](https://docs.rs#911)            if p.elapsed_s > 0.0 {
[912](https://docs.rs#912)                bits.push(format!("{:.0} rows/s", p.rows_per_s()));
[913](https://docs.rs#913)            }
[914](https://docs.rs#914)            if p.rows > 0 {
[915](https://docs.rs#915)                bits.push(format!("{} rows", human_count(p.rows)));
[916](https://docs.rs#916)            }
[917](https://docs.rs#917)            if p.bytes_read > 0 {
[918](https://docs.rs#918)                bits.push(format!("{} read", human_bytes(p.bytes_read)));
[919](https://docs.rs#919)            }
[920](https://docs.rs#920)            if p.inflight > 0 {
[921](https://docs.rs#921)                bits.push(format!("{} inflight", p.inflight));
[922](https://docs.rs#922)            }
[923](https://docs.rs#923)            if p.elapsed_s > 0.0 {
[924](https://docs.rs#924)                bits.push(format!("{:.1}s", p.elapsed_s));
[925](https://docs.rs#925)            }
[926](https://docs.rs#926)            if !bits.is_empty() {
[927](https://docs.rs#927)                ui.label(egui::RichText::new(bits.join("  ·  ")).monospace().color(th.text_dim));
[928](https://docs.rs#928)            }
[929](https://docs.rs#929)        }
[930](https://docs.rs#930)        ui.separator();
[931](https://docs.rs#931)        // FC-7: drive animation from the injected clock when pinned; otherwise
[932](https://docs.rs#932)        // follow egui's ambient wall-time for the live (non-test) UX.
[933](https://docs.rs#933)        let time = self.clock_s.unwrap_or_else(|| ui.input(|i| i.time));
[934](https://docs.rs#934)        self.paint_dag(ui, time);
[935](https://docs.rs#935)        // ── selected-node detail panel: status, rows, and the failure error ──
[936](https://docs.rs#936)        if let Some(name) = self.selected.clone() {
[937](https://docs.rs#937)            if let Some(node) = self.nodes.iter().find(|n| n.name == name) {
[938](https://docs.rs#938)                ui.separator();
[939](https://docs.rs#939)                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
[940](https://docs.rs#940)                    ui.strong(&node.name);
[941](https://docs.rs#941)                    ui.colored_label(node.status.theme_color(&th), node.status.label());
[942](https://docs.rs#942)                    if let Some(d) = &node.detail {
[943](https://docs.rs#943)                        ui.label(egui::RichText::new(d).color(th.text_dim));
[944](https://docs.rs#944)                    }
[945](https://docs.rs#945)                    if let Some(r) = node.rows {
[946](https://docs.rs#946)                        ui.label(egui::RichText::new(format!("{} rows", human_count(r))).monospace());
[947](https://docs.rs#947)                    }
[948](https://docs.rs#948)                    if let Some(t) = node.throughput_rows_s {
[949](https://docs.rs#949)                        ui.label(egui::RichText::new(format!("{t:.0} rows/s")).monospace().color(th.accent));
[950](https://docs.rs#950)                    }
[951](https://docs.rs#951)                    if let Some(l) = node.lag_s {
[952](https://docs.rs#952)                        ui.label(egui::RichText::new(format!("{l:.1}s lag")).monospace().color(th.text_dim));
[953](https://docs.rs#953)                    }
[954](https://docs.rs#954)                });
[955](https://docs.rs#955)                if let Some(err) = &node.error {
[956](https://docs.rs#956)                    ui.colored_label(Color32::from_rgb(224, 72, 72), format!("⚠ {err}"));
[957](https://docs.rs#957)                }
[958](https://docs.rs#958)            }
[959](https://docs.rs#959)        }
[960](https://docs.rs#960)        // ── render-lane emit: this Facet::ui path RAN ─────────────────────────
[961](https://docs.rs#961)        #[cfg(feature = "testmatrix")]
[962](https://docs.rs#962)        facett_core::testmatrix::emit(
[963](https://docs.rs#963)            "facett-pipeline::PipelineView::ui",
[964](https://docs.rs#964)            "ui_render",
[965](https://docs.rs#965)            !self.nodes.is_empty(),
[966](https://docs.rs#966)            &format!("nodes={} edges={}", self.nodes.len(), self.edge_ends.len()),
[967](https://docs.rs#967)        );
[968](https://docs.rs#968)    }
[969](https://docs.rs#969)    fn state_json(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
[970](https://docs.rs#970)        let (idle, running, done, failed) = self.counts();
[971](https://docs.rs#971)        // Per-node readable model: exactly what each box renders, so a headless
[972](https://docs.rs#972)        // test can assert a specific node's status / rows / error (LAW 6).
[973](https://docs.rs#973)        let nodes: Vec<serde_json::Value> = self
[974](https://docs.rs#974)            .nodes
[975](https://docs.rs#975)            .iter()
[976](https://docs.rs#976)            .map(|n| {
[977](https://docs.rs#977)                serde_json::json!({
[978](https://docs.rs#978)                    "name": n.name,
[979](https://docs.rs#979)                    "status": n.status.label(),
[980](https://docs.rs#980)                    "detail": n.detail,
[981](https://docs.rs#981)                    "rows": n.rows,
[982](https://docs.rs#982)                    "error": n.error,
[983](https://docs.rs#983)                    "throughput_rows_s": n.throughput_rows_s,
[984](https://docs.rs#984)                    "lag_s": n.lag_s,
[985](https://docs.rs#985)                })
[986](https://docs.rs#986)            })
[987](https://docs.rs#987)            .collect();
[988](https://docs.rs#988)        // The error(s) surfaced on failed nodes — pulled out for easy assertion.
[989](https://docs.rs#989)        let errors: Vec<serde_json::Value> = self
[990](https://docs.rs#990)            .nodes
[991](https://docs.rs#991)            .iter()
[992](https://docs.rs#992)            .filter(|n| n.status == Status::Failed)
[993](https://docs.rs#993)            .map(|n| serde_json::json!({ "node": n.name, "error": n.error }))
[994](https://docs.rs#994)            .collect();
[995](https://docs.rs#995)        let selected = self.selected.as_deref().and_then(|name| self.nodes.iter().find(|n| n.name == name)).map(|n| {
[996](https://docs.rs#996)            serde_json::json!({
[997](https://docs.rs#997)                "name": n.name,
[998](https://docs.rs#998)                "status": n.status.label(),
[999](https://docs.rs#999)                "detail": n.detail,
[1000](https://docs.rs#1000)                "rows": n.rows,
[1001](https://docs.rs#1001)                "error": n.error,
[1002](https://docs.rs#1002)            })
[1003](https://docs.rs#1003)        });
[1004](https://docs.rs#1004)        serde_json::json!({
[1005](https://docs.rs#1005)            "node_count": self.nodes.len(),
[1006](https://docs.rs#1006)            "edge_count": self.edge_ends.len(),
[1007](https://docs.rs#1007)            "nodes": nodes,
[1008](https://docs.rs#1008)            "statuses": { "idle": idle, "running": running, "done": done, "failed": failed },
[1009](https://docs.rs#1009)            "errors": errors,
[1010](https://docs.rs#1010)            "selected": selected,
[1011](https://docs.rs#1011)            "progress": self.progress.as_ref().map(|p| serde_json::json!({
[1012](https://docs.rs#1012)                "fraction": p.fraction,
[1013](https://docs.rs#1013)                "tasks_done": p.tasks_done,
[1014](https://docs.rs#1014)                "tasks_total": p.tasks_total,
[1015](https://docs.rs#1015)                "rows": p.rows,
[1016](https://docs.rs#1016)                "bytes_read": p.bytes_read,
[1017](https://docs.rs#1017)                "elapsed_s": p.elapsed_s,
[1018](https://docs.rs#1018)                "inflight": p.inflight,
[1019](https://docs.rs#1019)                "rows_per_s": p.rows_per_s(),
[1020](https://docs.rs#1020)            })),
[1021](https://docs.rs#1021)            "animated": self.animated,
[1022](https://docs.rs#1022)            "speed": self.speed,
[1023](https://docs.rs#1023)            // FC-8: a single observable quiescence flag — true when nothing is
[1024](https://docs.rs#1024)            // running and no task is in flight. A caller reads `idle` instead of
[1025](https://docs.rs#1025)            // guessing with a sleep.
[1026](https://docs.rs#1026)            "idle": self.is_idle(),
[1027](https://docs.rs#1027)            // FC-7: the injected clock (null = following ambient time).
[1028](https://docs.rs#1028)            "clock_s": self.clock_s,
[1029](https://docs.rs#1029)            // GAP #1: the shared camera, so navigation is headless-assertable
[1030](https://docs.rs#1030)            // (LAW: components emit what they render). `visible` = node boxes
[1031](https://docs.rs#1031)            // currently intersecting the last-fit scene bbox at this zoom.
[1032](https://docs.rs#1032)            "nav": {
[1033](https://docs.rs#1033)                "scale": self.nav.scale,
[1034](https://docs.rs#1034)                "offset": self.nav.offset,
[1035](https://docs.rs#1035)                "fitted": self.fitted,
[1036](https://docs.rs#1036)            },
[1037](https://docs.rs#1037)            "dag": self.dag.state_json(),
[1038](https://docs.rs#1038)        })
[1039](https://docs.rs#1039)    }
[1040](https://docs.rs#1040)    fn selection_json(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
[1041](https://docs.rs#1041)        match self.selected.as_deref().and_then(|name| self.nodes.iter().find(|n| n.name == name)) {
[1042](https://docs.rs#1042)            Some(n) => serde_json::json!({
[1043](https://docs.rs#1043)                "node": n.name,
[1044](https://docs.rs#1044)                "status": n.status.label(),
[1045](https://docs.rs#1045)                "error": n.error,
[1046](https://docs.rs#1046)            }),
[1047](https://docs.rs#1047)            None => serde_json::Value::Null,
[1048](https://docs.rs#1048)        }
[1049](https://docs.rs#1049)    }
[1050](https://docs.rs#1050)}
[1051](https://docs.rs#1051)
[1052](https://docs.rs#1052)/// Format a row/record count compactly (e.g. `12.0k`, `3.4M`). Pure + testable;
[1053](https://docs.rs#1053)/// the analogue of [`human_bytes`] for counts rather than bytes.
[1054](https://docs.rs#1054)pub fn human_count(n: u64) -> String {
[1055](https://docs.rs#1055)    if n < 1_000 {
[1056](https://docs.rs#1056)        return n.to_string();
[1057](https://docs.rs#1057)    }
[1058](https://docs.rs#1058)    let (v, unit) = if n < 1_000_000 {
[1059](https://docs.rs#1059)        (n as f64 / 1_000.0, "k")
[1060](https://docs.rs#1060)    } else if n < 1_000_000_000 {
[1061](https://docs.rs#1061)        (n as f64 / 1_000_000.0, "M")
[1062](https://docs.rs#1062)    } else {
[1063](https://docs.rs#1063)        (n as f64 / 1_000_000_000.0, "B")
[1064](https://docs.rs#1064)    };
[1065](https://docs.rs#1065)    format!("{v:.1}{unit}")
[1066](https://docs.rs#1066)}
[1067](https://docs.rs#1067)
[1068](https://docs.rs#1068)/// Format a byte count with binary units (`512 B`, `1.0 KiB`, `3.5 MiB`).
[1069](https://docs.rs#1069)/// Mirrors knut's `human_bytes` so edge/throughput labels read the same.
[1070](https://docs.rs#1070)pub fn human_bytes(n: u64) -> String {
[1071](https://docs.rs#1071)    const UNITS: [&str; 6] = ["B", "KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB"];
[1072](https://docs.rs#1072)    if n < 1024 {
[1073](https://docs.rs#1073)        return format!("{n} B");
[1074](https://docs.rs#1074)    }
[1075](https://docs.rs#1075)    let mut v = n as f64;
[1076](https://docs.rs#1076)    let mut u = 0;
[1077](https://docs.rs#1077)    while v >= 1024.0 && u < UNITS.len() - 1 {
[1078](https://docs.rs#1078)        v /= 1024.0;
[1079](https://docs.rs#1079)        u += 1;
[1080](https://docs.rs#1080)    }
[1081](https://docs.rs#1081)    format!("{v:.1} {}", UNITS[u])
[1082](https://docs.rs#1082)}
[1083](https://docs.rs#1083)
[1084](https://docs.rs#1084)#[cfg(test)]

[1088](https://docs.rs#1088)    #[test]
[1089](https://docs.rs#1089)    fn typed_copy_is_selected_node_or_whole_dag_rows() {
[1090](https://docs.rs#1090)        use facett_core::clip::{ClipKind, ClipPayload, CopySource};
[1091](https://docs.rs#1091)        let v = PipelineView::new(
[1092](https://docs.rs#1092)            "p",
[1093](https://docs.rs#1093)            vec![("src".into(), Status::Done), ("sink".into(), Status::Running)],
[1094](https://docs.rs#1094)            vec![(0, 1)],
[1095](https://docs.rs#1095)        );
[1096](https://docs.rs#1096)        // No selection -> the whole DAG as a TSV rectangle (header + one row/node).
[1097](https://docs.rs#1097)        let p = v.copy_payload().expect("nodes copy");
[1098](https://docs.rs#1098)        assert_eq!(p.kind(), ClipKind::Rows);
[1099](https://docs.rs#1099)        let text = p.as_text();
[1100](https://docs.rs#1100)        assert!(text.starts_with("name\tstatus\trows\terror"), "header first: {text}");
[1101](https://docs.rs#1101)        assert!(text.contains("\nsrc\tdone\t\t"), "src row present: {text}");
[1102](https://docs.rs#1102)        // Selecting a node narrows the copy to that node's line.
[1103](https://docs.rs#1103)        let v = v.with_selected("sink");
[1104](https://docs.rs#1104)        let sel = v.copy_payload().unwrap();
[1105](https://docs.rs#1105)        assert_eq!(sel.as_text(), "sink\trunning\t\t");
[1106](https://docs.rs#1106)        assert!(matches!(sel, ClipPayload::Rows(_)));
[1107](https://docs.rs#1107)    }
[1108](https://docs.rs#1108)

[1110](https://docs.rs#1110)    fn counts_and_state_json() {

[1112](https://docs.rs#1112)            "pipe",
[1113](https://docs.rs#1113)            vec![
[1114](https://docs.rs#1114)                ("src".into(), Status::Done),
[1115](https://docs.rs#1115)                ("mid".into(), Status::Running),
[1116](https://docs.rs#1116)                ("sink".into(), Status::Idle),
[1117](https://docs.rs#1117)            ],

[1121](https://docs.rs#1121)

[1134](https://docs.rs#1134)    #[test]
[1135](https://docs.rs#1135)    fn edge_phase_wraps_and_increases() {
[1136](https://docs.rs#1136)        // speed 0 → frozen at 0.
[1137](https://docs.rs#1137)        assert_eq!(edge_phase(123.4, 0.0), 0.0);
[1138](https://docs.rs#1138)        assert_eq!(edge_phase(5.0, -1.0), 0.0, "non-positive speed freezes");
[1139](https://docs.rs#1139)        // phase is in [0,1) and advances with time.
[1140](https://docs.rs#1140)        let speed = 0.5;
[1141](https://docs.rs#1141)        let p0 = edge_phase(0.0, speed);
[1142](https://docs.rs#1142)        let p1 = edge_phase(0.4, speed);
[1143](https://docs.rs#1143)        assert!((0.0..1.0).contains(&p0) && (0.0..1.0).contains(&p1));
[1144](https://docs.rs#1144)        assert!(p1 > p0, "phase advances over the first cycle");
[1145](https://docs.rs#1145)        // wraps: one full cycle (2.0s at 0.5 c/s) returns to ~0.
[1146](https://docs.rs#1146)        let wrapped = edge_phase(2.0, speed);
[1147](https://docs.rs#1147)        assert!(wrapped < 1e-3 || (1.0 - wrapped) < 1e-3, "phase wraps each cycle, got {wrapped}");
[1148](https://docs.rs#1148)        // monotone-mod over many samples, always bounded.
[1149](https://docs.rs#1149)        for k in 0..500 {
[1150](https://docs.rs#1150)            let v = edge_phase(k as f64 * 0.013, 1.7);
[1151](https://docs.rs#1151)            assert!((0.0..1.0).contains(&v), "phase bounded, got {v}");
[1152](https://docs.rs#1152)        }
[1153](https://docs.rs#1153)    }
[1154](https://docs.rs#1154)
[1155](https://docs.rs#1155)    #[test]
[1156](https://docs.rs#1156)    fn status_glow_curve_matches_each_state() {
[1157](https://docs.rs#1157)        // idle never glows; done/failed are steady; running pulses within bounds.
[1158](https://docs.rs#1158)        assert_eq!(status_glow(Status::Idle, 1.23, 0.6), 0.0);
[1159](https://docs.rs#1159)        assert_eq!(status_glow(Status::Done, 1.23, 0.6), 0.35);
[1160](https://docs.rs#1160)        assert_eq!(status_glow(Status::Failed, 1.23, 0.6), 0.9);
[1161](https://docs.rs#1161)        let mut lo = f32::MAX;
[1162](https://docs.rs#1162)        let mut hi = f32::MIN;
[1163](https://docs.rs#1163)        for k in 0..400 {
[1164](https://docs.rs#1164)            let v = status_glow(Status::Running, k as f64 * 0.05, 0.6);
[1165](https://docs.rs#1165)            assert!((0.0..=1.0).contains(&v), "running glow bounded, got {v}");
[1166](https://docs.rs#1166)            lo = lo.min(v);
[1167](https://docs.rs#1167)            hi = hi.max(v);
[1168](https://docs.rs#1168)        }
[1169](https://docs.rs#1169)        assert!(hi - lo > 0.2, "running status actually pulses (range {lo}..{hi})");
[1170](https://docs.rs#1170)    }
